days_to_civil.brief: 把纪元天数转换为公历年月日 / Convert a day count since the epoch to a civil date

params.day: out:公历日 / Receives the day of month

civil_to_days.brief: 把公历年月日转换为纪元天数 / Convert a civil date to a day count since the epoch

day_of_week.brief: 由纪元天数求星期几 / Get the weekday from a day count since the epoch

day_of_week.return: 星期几，0 表示周日 / The weekday with 0 meaning Sunday

date_value.brief: 读取 Date 实例的时间值 / Read the time value of a Date instance

date_static_utc.details: 按 `(y, m, d, h, mi, s, ms)` 处理，月份 0 起、越界回卷；仅当提供了至少两个参数且年在 0..99 时按 1900+ 解释。| Fields follow `(y, m, d, h, mi, s, ms)` with zero-based months and roll-over; a year in 0..99 is read as 1900+ only when at least two arguments were supplied.

d_arg.return: 第 i 个实参或 `undefined` / The i-th argument or `undefined`
